      install.packages(pkg)
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    } else {
      library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
    }
  }

  }
  outName = sub("\\..*$", "", basename(fileName))

  numLines = nrow(dfall)
  print(paste('Initial row count:',nrow(dfall)))
  
# Create a column with the sum of the Delta scores
  if ("spliceAI_DS_AL" %in% colnames(dfall)){
    dfall$sAI_delta = as.numeric(dfall$'spliceAI_DS_AG')+ as.numeric(dfall$'spliceAI_DS_AL')+ as.numeric(dfall$'spliceAI_DS_DG')+as.numeric(dfall$'spliceAI_DS_DL')
    dfall$sAI_delta <- dfall$sAI_delta %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
  }
 
# Create a nummeric colum fro promoter AI    
  if ("promoterAI_score"%in% colnames(dfall)) {
    dfall$promoterAInum = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dfall$promoterAI_score))
    dfall$promoterAInum <- dfall$promoterAInum %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
  }

  # create a numeric column for Depth
  if ("AD_ALT" %in% colnames(dfall) & "AD_REF" %in% colnames(dfall)) { dfall$newDP <- as.numeric(dfall$AD_ALT)+as.numeric(dfall$AD_REF)}

)

dfall[dfall == ""] <- NA
#create a coluimn  to score variants
dfall$VScore <- 0

#Line to report Variant filtering based on the original file
printFilter <- function(df, param){
  print(paste('Number of variants removed for',param,'is:',numLines - nrow(dfall)))
  numLines <<- nrow(dfall)
  print(paste(numLines,'variants remain.'))
}
  
  allDups = function(value){duplicated(value) | duplicated(value, fromLast = TRUE)}

 ###########################Collect and score variants from disease databases######################### 

############################Collect variants from ClinVar
  MPOterms <- c("vision", "eye", "retina", "macula")
                                  #identify rows with at leat one of those patterns
                                  id5 <- !is.na(dfall$MPO) & grepl(paste(MPOterms, collapse = "|"), dfall$MPO, ignore.case = TRUE)
                                  # add a+1 for the row containing the pattern
                                  dfall$VScore[id5] <- dfall$VScore[id5] + 0.5
                                  
                                  
                       if("Clinvar_SIG"%in% colnames(dfall))  {
                                            # Add +30 for scoring pathogenic and Likely_pathogenic 
                                            
                                            #terms pattern
                                            cvterms <- c("Pathogenic", "Likely_pathogenic")
                                            idcv1 <- !is.na(dfall$Clinvar_SIG) &                                                 grepl(paste(cvterms, collapse = "|"), dfall$Clinvar_SIG, ignore.case = TRUE) &
                                            !grepl("Conflicting_classifications_of_pathogenicity",
                                             dfall$Clinvar_SIG) 
                                            dfall$VScore[idcv1] <- dfall$VScore[idcv1] + 30
                                            # Collect ClinVar Pathogenic and likely pathogenic CNVs
                                            ClinVar1 <- dfall[idcv1, ]
                                            # Add +2 for scoring
                                            idcv2 <- grepl("Uncertain", dfall$Clinvar_SIG, ignore.case = TRUE)  
                                            dfall$VScore[idcv2] <- dfall$VScore[idcv2] + 2
                                            # Collect ClinVar VUS 
                                            ClinVar2 <- dfall[grepl("Uncertain",dfall$Clinvar_SIG, ignore.case = TRUE), ]
                                            #merge, delete duplicated SNVs
                                            mergedClinVar <- rbind(ClinVar1, ClinVar2)
                                            #delete duplicated SNVs
                                            mClinVar <- mergedClinVar[!duplicated(mergedClinVar), ]
                                            ClinV_text <- "Number of SNVs overlapping ClinVar P, LP, VUS"
                                            Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, ClinV_text)
                                                  Counter$Count <- c(Counter$Count, nrow(mClinVar))
                                            }

    cat("Keeping Allele freq lower than 0.5% large databases and 1% internal databases.\n")

if (interactive()) {
                    ans1 <- tolower(trimws(readline("Do you want to use a panel? [yes/no]: ")))
                      }
if (ans1 %in% c("y", "yes")  &&  "gene_symbol" %in% colnames(dfall)) {
                    #open panel and read
                     print('Input gene panel file')
                     fileName = file.choose()
                     print(fileName)
                      if(!tolower(data.table::last(unlist(strsplit(fileName,'\\.'))))%in%c('tsv','csv','txt','dsv')){
                                                                                                                    stop("Unsupported file format",call. = F)
                                                                                                                                                             } 
                      panel = read.table(fileName, header=T, colClasses = "character")
                      #count number of entries
                      nrowpanel <- nrow(panel)
                      print(paste('Number of panel genes:',nrowpanel))
                      ####################keep variants in a separate dataframe that matches the                           #genes from the list, regardless if they are separated by | or ;
                      panel_genes <- panel[[1]] #  gene names are in the first column
                      
                      # Combine gene names into a regex OR pattern
                      panel_pattern <- paste0("(^|[;|])", panel_genes, "($|[;|])")
                      # now it gets all gene names and understands as patterns to be searched
                      combined_pattern <- paste(panel_pattern, collapse = "|")
                       # Add +50 for scoring
                       id <- grepl(combined_pattern, dfall$gene_symbol)
                        dfall$VScore[id] <- dfall$VScore[id] + 50
                      
                      # Subset dfall where gene_symbol column matches any of the panel genes
                      panelSNV <- dfall[grepl(combined_pattern, dfall$gene_symbol), ]
                      print(paste(nrow(panelSNV),'SNVs from genes in the  panel were saved.'))
                      Panel_Text <- "SNVs from panel were saved."
                      Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, Panel_Text)
                      Counter$Count <- c(Counter$Count, nrow(panelSNV))
                      }
  
  ################################Quality filter optional############################
###later ask user if user wants to apply this filter

                    }

    
   if (ans2 %in% c("y", "yes") && "FILTER"%in% colnames(dfall)) {

    keepP <- "Variants with FILTER != PASS were removed."
                      Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, keepP)
                      Counter$Count <- c(Counter$Count, nrow(dfall))
    
   }

                    }

    dfall <- dfall[as.numeric(dfall$newDP)>=5 & as.numeric(dfall$newDP)<=120,]
    printFilter(dfall, 'remove if read depth not within 5-120')
    
    Quality_Text <- "Quality Filter:  5 > Depth > 120"
    
    Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, Quality_Text)
    Counter$Count <- c(Counter$Count, nrow(dfall))
                                                 }
###################Variant scoring################################   
#score predictors    
   user_cutoffs <- list(
    # sift_scorecutoff = 0.05,
   # polyphen_scorecutoff = 0.8,
    #ma_scorecutoff = 2,
    #spx_dpsicutoff = 2,
    phylopPMam_avgcutoff = 1.5,
    phylopVert100_avgcutoff = 4,
    PROVEAN_scorecutoff = -2.5,
    CADD_phredcutoff = 15,
    alpha_missense_scorecuttoff = 0.8,
    primateai3d_scorecuttoff = 0.8,
    MPC_scorecutoff = 2,
    REVEL_cutoff = 0.5
  )
 
  # Calculate full cutoff scores
  predVote = suppressWarnings(cbind(
    #as.numeric(dfall$sift_score) <= user_cutoffs$sift_scorecutoff, 
    #as.numeric(dfall$polyphen_score) >= user_cutoffs$polyphen_scorecutoff, 
    #as.numeric(dfall$ma_score) >= user_cutoffs$ma_scorecutoff,
   # abs(as.numeric(dfall$spx_dpsi)) <= user_cutoffs$spx_dpsicutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$phylopMam_avg) >= user_cutoffs$phylopPMam_avgcutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$phylopVert100_avg) >= user_cutoffs$phylopVert100_avgcutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$PROVEAN_score) <= user_cutoffs$PROVEAN_scorecutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$CADD_phred) >= user_cutoffs$CADD_phredcutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$alpha_missense) >= user_cutoffs$alpha_missensecutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$primateai3d) >= user_cutoffs$primateai3dcutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$MPC_score) >= user_cutoffs$MPC_scorecutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$CADD_phred) >= user_cutoffs$CADD_phredcutoff,
    as.numeric(dfall$REVEL_score) >= user_cutoffs$REVEL_cutoff
  ))
  
  # identify rows that follow the condition
  ind <- rowSums(predVote, na.rm = TRUE)
  #tab <- dfall[ind>=1,] line to test if the variants with the conditions above were selected
  #add a point to those rows in the main table
  dfall$VScore[ind>=1] <- dfall$VScore[ind>=1]+1  
  
  #Loop that looks at some other significant scores
 
  ### effecft priory. Add 15 points to LOF, and +2 points to nonframeshift, startloss, and stoploss 
   
  if ("effect_priority" %in% colnames(dfall)) {
                                               #Select LOF add +15 to score
                                                LOF <- c('frameshift deletion','frameshift insertion', 'stopgain')
                                                id1 <- !is.na(dfall$effect_priority) & dfall$effect_priority%in%LOF                                                                                                     
                                               #add score
                                                dfall$VScore[id1] <- dfall$VScore[id1] + 15
                                                
                                              #add starloss nonframeshift
                                                Other <-  c('nonframeshift insertion','nonframeshift deletion', 'startloss', 'stoploss')
                                                id2 <- !is.na(dfall$effect_priority) & dfall$effect_priority%in%Other
                                                 #add score
                                                dfall$VScore[id2] <- dfall$VScore[id2] + 5
                                                }
    
  
if ("sAI_delta" %in% colnames(dfall)) {        ########avoid loop, detect pattern, splice AI delta score over or equal 0.2
                                               id3 <- !is.na(dfall$sAI_delta) & dfall$sAI_delta >= 0.2
                                               ##add +1  score###########
                                               dfall$VScore[id3] <- dfall$VScore[id3] + 1
                                               # recognize splice AI delta score  over or equal 0.1, less than 0.2
                                               id4 <- !is.na(dfall$sAI_delta) & dfall$sAI_delta >= 0.1 & dfall$sAI_delta < 0.2
                                               ##add +0.5  score###########
                                               dfall$VScore[id4] <- dfall$VScore[id4] + 0.5
                                                               
                                                                   }
                                   
# 6. MPO column
  if ("MPO" %in% colnames(dfall)) {
                                  # select terms. Be aware that phenotype may have more than one select terms
                                  MPOterms <- c("vision", "eye", "retina", "macula")
                                  #identify rows with at leat one of those patterns
                                  id5 <- !is.na(dfall$MPO) & grepl(paste(MPOterms, collapse = "|"), dfall$MPO, ignore.case = TRUE)
                                  # add a+1 for the row containing the pattern
                                  dfall$VScore[id5] <- dfall$VScore[id5] + 0.5
                                   } 

# 7. HPO column
  if ("HPO" %in% colnames(dfall)) {
                                  # select terms. Be aware that phenotype may have more than one select terms
                                  HPOterms <- c("vision", "eye", "retina", "macula")
                                  #identify rows with at leat one of those patterns
                                  id6 <- !is.na(dfall$HPO) & grepl(paste(HPOterms, collapse = "|"), dfall$HPO, ignore.case = TRUE)
                                  # add a+1 for the row containing the pattern
                                  dfall$VScore[id6] <- dfall$VScore[id6] + 0.5
                                   } 
  

 # 8.FANTOM5 
 
  if ("Fantom5DPI" %in% colnames(dfall)) {
                                          id7 <- !is.na(dfall$Fantom5DPI) & dfall$Fantom5DPI == 2
                                          dfall$VScore[id7] <- dfall$VScore[id7] + 0.5
                                          }
  
  # 9.PromoterAI
 if ("promoterAInum" %in% colnames(dfall)) { 
                                         id8 <-abs(as.numeric(dfall$promoterAInum)) > 0.1
                                         dfall$VScore[id8] <- dfall$VScore[id8] + 0.5
                                        }
  
   
  
  dfall <- dfall[order(-dfall$VScore), ] 
  
#############################Varinat filtering ############################
    
   

  
  # keep promoterAI data
  #dfall$promoterAInum = suppressWarnings(as.numeric(dfall$promoterAI_score))
  if ("promoterAI_score"%in% colnames(dfall)) {promoterAI <- dfall[!is.na(dfall$promoterAInum) &                                                       (dfall$promoterAInum > 0.1 | dfall$promoterAInum < -0.1),]
              print(paste(nrow(promoterAI),'SNVs of with absolute promoterAI values > 0.1 were saved.'))
                              PAI <- "SNVs of with absolute promoterAI values > 0.1 were saved."
                      Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, PAI)
                      Counter$Count <- c(Counter$Count, nrow(promoterAI))
                                               }
  
  #Keep FANTOM5 categorical data  2 (robust)
  if ("Fantom5DPI"%in% colnames(dfall))  {FANTOM5 = dfall [ dfall$Fantom5DPI%in%"2",]
  print(paste(nrow(FANTOM5),'SNVs overlapping robust FANTOM5 motifs were saved.'))
  F5txt <- "SNVs overlapping robust FANTOM5 motifs were saved."
                      Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, PAI)
                      Counter$Count <- c(Counter$Count, nrow(FANTOM5))
                                          }
  
  
  RemoveforGenic <-  c('downstream','intergenic','ncRNA_exonic','ncRNA_intronic','ncRNA_splicing','ncRNA_UTR3','ncRNA_UTR5','upstream','upstream;downstream','UTR3','UTR5','UTR5;UTR3','ncRNA_exonic;ncRNA_splicing')
  
  dfall <-dfall[!dfall$typeseq_priority%in%RemoveforGenic,]

  Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, GenicText)

#then coerce the required columns into a numeric format
cat("Splice AI filtering - cutoff is 0.1.\n")
#Filering for variants that have a Splice AI scoreabove cutoff#
spliceAI_data = dfall[as.numeric(dfall[,'sAI_delta'])>= 0.1,]
print(paste(nrow(spliceAI_data),'variants with sum  of delta score in SpliceAI2 over 0.1 were saved.'))

#######collect dbscSNV_ADA_SCORE over 0.6
dfall$dbscSNV_ADA_SCORE <- dfall$dbscSNV_ADA_SCORE %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
dfall$dbscSNV_RF_SCORE <- dfall$dbscSNV_RF_SCORE %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
dbscSNV1 = dfall[as.numeric(dfall[,'dbscSNV_ADA_SCORE'])>=0.6,]
dbscSNV2 = dfall[as.numeric(dfall[,'dbscSNV_RF_SCORE'])>=0.6,]
dbscSNV = rbind(dbscSNV1, dbscSNV2)
dbscSNV=dbscSNV[!duplicated(dbscSNV), ]

Splice = rbind(spliceAI_data, dbscSNV)
Splice= Splice[!duplicated(Splice), ]


Splice_Text <- "kept Splice AI sum of delta score >0.1 and dbscSNV (ADA or RF) >=0.6 splice Filtering"
Splice_Row <- nrow(Splice)
Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, Splice_Text)
Counter$Count <- c(Counter$Count, Splice_Row)

  # if (length(dup_cols) > 0) {

  #keep loss of function 
  LOFkeep <- c('frameshift deletion', 'frameshift insertion','stoploss','stopgain','startloss','startgain')
  LOF <- dfall[dfall$effect_priority%in%LOFkeep,]
  #nonframeshift indels
  keep2 = c('nonframeshift insertion','nonframeshift deletion')
  LOF2 = dfall[dfall$effect_priority%in%keep2,]
  LOF2$dbsnp_region <- LOF2$dbsnp_region %>% replace(is.na(.), 0)
  LOF2 = LOF2[str_count(as.character(LOF2$dbsnp_region), ',')<=4,]
  LOF2$dbsnp_region[LOF2$dbsnp_region == 0] <- NA

 effect_data <- rbind(LOF,LOF2)

    as.numeric(dfall$REVEL_score) >= user_cutoffs$REVEL_cutoff))
  
  ind = rowSums(predVote, na.rm=TRUE)
  pathogenicfilter_data = dfall[ind>=2,]
   Path_Text <- "Saved genic variants with two predictive scores over set threshold"
  Counter$Step <- c(Counter$Step, Path_Text)

  with_PAI_F5 <- c("promoterAI_score", "Fantom5DPI")

   Strong_Var_Row <- nrow(dfall)
